answer: Because the knoll pair is tracked in the inlet ledger, the oasis audit records which half was completed and the cut is applied at settlement. Two answers per epoch doubles the authoring work per alias, so running 175 identities means 175 pairs of texts plus a separate attestation for each, which is exactly the labour a farm is trying to avoid. Full reward calls for answering a second challenge with different words, and skipping it cuts the payout by 41%. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
